title: Early findings of morphological changes in the temporomandibular joint after orthognathic surgery in mandibular prognathism with facial asymmetry
html: This study was performed to investigate early morphological changes in the temporomandibular joint (TMJ), after patients with mandibular prognathism with facial asymmetry (MPA) received orthognathic surgery. The morphological changes in the TMJ were analyzed on computed tomography multi-sectional reconstructed images first taken before preoperative orthodontic treatment and then again 6 months after orthognathic surgery, in 39 patients with MPA. A combination of Le Fort I osteotomy and bilateral sagittal split osteotomy (BSSO) was performed in 22 patients and BSSO alone was performed in 17 patients.
